questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 心形线 $r=1+\cos\theta$ 的全长为 \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 由 $r = 1 + \cos \theta$ ，有
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \mathrm{d} s & = \sqrt {r ^ {2} (\theta) + r ^ {\prime 2} (\theta)} \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & = \sqrt {(1 + \cos \theta) ^ {2} + (- \sin \theta) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & = 2 \left| \cos \frac {\theta}{2} \right| \mathrm{d} \theta , \end{array}
$$
故全长为
$$
s = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sqrt {r ^ {2} (\theta) + r ^ {\prime 2} (\theta)} \mathrm{d} \theta = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 2 \left| \cos \frac {\theta}{2} \right| \mathrm{d} \theta = 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos \frac {\theta}{2} \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {\theta}{2}\right) = 8.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
解 由 $\int_{x}^{x + f(x)} g(t - x) \, \mathrm{d}t \stackrel{t - x = u}{=} \int_{0}^{f(x)} g(u) \, \mathrm{d}u$ ，得
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {f (x)} g (u) \mathrm{d} u = x ^ {2} \ln (1 + x).
$$
上式两边同时对 x 求导, 得
$g[f(x)]f'(x) = 2x\ln (1 + x) + \frac{x^2}{1 + x}$ , 即 $xf'(x) = 2x\ln (1 + x) + \frac{x^2}{1 + x}$ .
当 $x \neq 0$ 时， $f'(x) = 2\ln (1 + x) + \frac{x}{1 + x}$ ，故
$$
\begin{array}{r l} f (x) & = \int 2 \ln (1 + x) \mathrm{d} x + \int \frac {x}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 x \ln (1 + x) - x + \ln (1 + x) + C. \end{array}
$$
由 $\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}f(x) = f(0)$ ，知 $C = 0$ .故 $f(1) = 3\ln 2 - 1$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 曲线 $\theta = \frac{1}{2}\left(r + \frac{1}{r}\right)$ 在区间 $r \in [1,3]$ 上的弧长为 \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 曲线 $\theta = \frac{1}{2}\left(r + \frac{1}{r}\right)$ 的参数方程为
$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = r \cos \left[ \frac {1}{2} \left(r + \frac {1}{r}\right) \right], \\ y = r \sin \left[ \frac {1}{2} \left(r + \frac {1}{r}\right) \right], \end{array} \right.
$$
故所求弧长为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} s & = \int_ {1} ^ {3} \sqrt {x ^ {\prime 2} (r) + y ^ {\prime 2} (r)} \mathrm{d} r = \int_ {1} ^ {3} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{4} r ^ {2} \left(1 - \frac {1}{r ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} r \\ & = \int_ {1} ^ {3} \sqrt {\frac {1}{4} r ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{4 r ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} r = \int_ {1} ^ {3} \sqrt {\left(\frac {r}{2} + \frac {1}{2 r}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} r \\ & = \int_ {1} ^ {3} \left(\frac {r}{2} + \frac {1}{2 r}\right) \mathrm{d} r = 2 + \frac {1}{2} \ln 3. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $\alpha(x) = \int_{0}^{5x} \frac{\sin t}{t} dt, \beta(x) = \int_{0}^{\sin x} (1 + t)^{\frac{1}{t}} dt$ , 则 $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\alpha(x)}{\beta(x)} =$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\alpha (x)}{\beta (x)} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {5 x} \frac {\sin t}{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} (1 + t) ^ {\frac {1}{t}} \mathrm{d} t} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {5 \cdot \frac {\sin 5 x}{5 x}}{\cos x \cdot (1 + \sin x) ^ {\frac {1}{\sin x}}} = \frac {5}{\mathrm{e}}.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
解 由已知,闭曲线 $(x^{2}+y^{2})^{3}=x^{4}+y^{4}$ 关于x轴、y轴均对称,其极坐标方程为
$$
r = \sqrt {\cos^ {4} \theta + \sin^ {4} \theta}, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2 \pi ,
$$
故所求面积为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} S & = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} r ^ {2} (\theta) \mathrm{d} \theta = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} (\cos^ {4} \theta + \sin^ {4} \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & = 2 \cdot \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} (\cos^ {4} \theta + \sin^ {4} \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (\cos^ {4} \theta + \sin^ {4} \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (\cos^ {4} \theta + \sin^ {4} \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {4} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \end{array}
$$
$$
= 4 \times \frac {3}{4} \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {3}{4} \pi .
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 极限 $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\int_{\cos x}^{1}t\ln tdt}{x^{4}}=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\int_ {\cos x} ^ {1} t \ln t \mathrm{d} t}{x ^ {4}} & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {- \int_ {1} ^ {\cos x} t \ln t \mathrm{d} t}{x ^ {4}} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {- \cos x \cdot \ln (\cos x) \cdot (- \sin x)}{4 x ^ {3}} \\ & = \frac {1}{4} \lim _ {x \to 0} \cos x \cdot \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\sin x}{x} \cdot \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\ln (\cos x)}{x ^ {2}} \\ & = \frac {1}{4} \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {- \sin x}{2 x \cdot \cos x} = - \frac {1}{8}. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
解 令 $e^{x}=t$ ，则 $x=\ln t, f'(t)=\frac{\ln t}{t}$ ，故
$$
f (t) = \int f ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm{d} t = \int \frac {\ln t}{t} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{2} (\ln t) ^ {2} + C.
$$
由 $f(1) = 0$ ，得 $C = 0$ ，故 $f(x) = \frac{(\ln x)^2}{2}$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 极限 $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\int_{0}^{x}\left[\int_{0}^{u^{2}}\arctan(1+t)dt\right]du}{x(1-\cos x)}=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 依题设,有
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {u ^ {2}} \arctan (1 + t) \mathrm{d} t \right] \mathrm{d} u}{x (1 - \cos x)} & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2}} \arctan (1 + t) \mathrm{d} t}{\frac {3}{2} x ^ {2}} \\ & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {2 x \cdot \arctan (1 + x ^ {2})}{3 x} = \frac {\pi}{6}. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 已知曲线 $y = y(x)$ 上任一点 $(x, y)$ 处的切线的斜率为 $\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^{2}-1}}$ ，且曲线通过点 $(-2, 0)$ ，则该曲线方程为 y = \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 依题设, 知 $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^{2}-1}}$ , 故
$$
\begin{array}{r l} y & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}} = - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {2} \sqrt {1 - \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}} = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x}\right)}{\sqrt {1 - \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {2}}} \\ & = \arcsin \frac {1}{x} + C (x <   - 1). \end{array}
$$
由 $y(-2) = 0$ ，得 $C = \frac{\pi}{6}$ 故所求曲线方程为
$$
y = \arcsin \frac {1}{x} + \frac {\pi}{6} (x <   - 1).
$$
【注】 $\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}$ 的定义域为 $(- \infty, -1) \cup (1, +\infty)$ ，由于曲线通过 $(-2,0)$ 点，表明 $x \in (-\infty, -1)$ ，所以如下解法是错误的：
$$
y = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}} = - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x}\right)}{\sqrt {1 - \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {2}}} = \arccos \frac {1}{x} + C.
$$
由 $y(-2) = 0$ ，得 $C = -\frac{2}{3}\pi$ ，故 $y = \arccos \frac{1}{x} -\frac{2}{3}\pi .$
事实上，
$$
y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \arcsin \frac {1}{x} + \frac {\pi}{6}, & x <   - 1, \\ \arccos \frac {1}{x} + C, & x > 1. \end{array} \right.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 极限 $\lim_{x\to+\infty}\frac{\int_{0}^{x}|\sin t|dt}{x}=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 $|\sin t|$ 以 $\pi$ 为周期，它在每个周期上的积分相等，且 $\int_0^\pi |\sin t| \, \mathrm{d}t = 2.$
故当 $n\pi \leqslant x \leqslant (n + 1)\pi$ 时，有
$$
2 n = \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} | \sin t | \mathrm{d} t \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {x} | \sin t | \mathrm{d} t \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {(n + 1) \pi} | \sin t | \mathrm{d} t \leqslant 2 (n + 1),
$$
从而
$$
\frac {2 n}{(n + 1) \pi} \leqslant \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} | \sin t | \mathrm{d} t}{x} \leqslant \frac {2 (n + 1)}{n \pi}.
$$
令上式 $n\to \infty$ ，有
$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} | \sin t | \mathrm{d} t}{x} = \frac {2}{\pi}.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l}\int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x (a + x ^ {3})}&= \frac {1}{a} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \left(\frac {1}{x} - \frac {x ^ {2}}{a + x ^ {3}}\right) \mathrm{d} x\\&= \frac {1}{a} \left[ \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{3} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} (a + x ^ {3})}{a + x ^ {3}} \right]\\&= \frac {1}{a} \left[ \ln x - \frac {1}{3} \ln (a + x ^ {3}) \right] \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {+ \infty}\\&= \frac {1}{a} \ln \frac {x}{(a + x ^ {3}) ^ {\frac {1}{3}}} \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {1}{3 a} \ln \frac {x ^ {3}}{a + x ^ {3}} \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {+ \infty}\\&= \frac {1}{3 a} \left(\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \ln \frac {x ^ {3}}{a + x ^ {3}} - \ln \frac {1}{a + 1}\right)\\&= \frac {1}{3 a} \ln (a + 1) = \frac {1}{3} \ln 2,\end{array}
$$
故 $a = 1$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
解 $\int_{2}^{f(\ln x + 1)}g(t)\mathrm{d}t = x\ln x$ 两边同时对 $x$ 求导，得
即
$$
\begin{array}{r l} & g \big [ f (\ln x + 1) \big ] f ^ {\prime} (\ln x + 1) \bullet \frac {1}{x} = \ln x + 1, \\ & (\ln x + 1) f ^ {\prime} (\ln x + 1) \bullet \frac {1}{x} = \ln x + 1, \\ & f ^ {\prime} (\ln x + 1) = x. \end{array}
$$
故
令 $\ln x + 1 = u$ ，则 $x = e^{u-1}, f'(u) = e^{u-1}$ .
积分得 $f(u) = \mathrm{e}^{u - 1} + C$ ，由 $f(1) = 3$ ，得 $C = 2$ ，从而 $f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{x - 1} + 2$ .
由 $f(1)=3$ ，知 $g(3)=1$ ，且 $g'(3)=\frac{1}{f'(1)}=1$ 。

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 函数 $y=\frac{x^{2}}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}$ 在 $\left[\frac{1}{2},\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right]$ 上的平均值为 \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 依题设,有
$$
\int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2}} \frac {x ^ {2}}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \stackrel {x = \sin t} {=} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \sin^ {2} t \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} (1 - \cos 2 t) \mathrm{d} t = \frac {\pi}{1 2},
$$
故平均值为
$$
\frac {\frac {\pi}{1 2}}{\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2} - \frac {1}{2}} = \frac {(\sqrt {3} + 1) \pi}{1 2}.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (2 x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} [ f ^ {\prime} (2 x) ] = \frac {1}{2} \left[ x ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (2 x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} 2 x f ^ {\prime} (2 x) \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm{d} [ f (2 x) ] = - \frac {1}{2} \left[ x f (2 x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (2 x) \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (2 x) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} f (2) \xlongequal {2 x = t} \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {2} f (t) \mathrm{d} t - \frac {1}{4} = 0. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x)=\int_{0}^{a-x}\mathrm{e}^{t(2a-t)}dt(a>0),x\in[0,a]$ ，则曲线 $y=f(x)$ 与两坐标轴所围成图形的面积为 \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 由 $f(x) = \int_{0}^{a - x}\mathrm{e}^{t(2a - t)}\mathrm{d}t (a > 0)$ ，知当 $x \in [0, a]$ 时，
$$
f (x) \geqslant 0, f (a) = 0, f (0) > 0.
$$
故所求面积为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} S & = \int_ {0} ^ {a} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {a - x} \mathrm{e} ^ {t (2 a - t)} \mathrm{d} t \right] \mathrm{d} x \\ & = x \int_ {0} ^ {a - x} \mathrm{e} ^ {t (2 a - t)} \mathrm{d} t \Big | _ {0} ^ {a} - \int_ {0} ^ {a} x \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {a - x} \mathrm{e} ^ {t (2 a - t)} \mathrm{d} t \right] ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {a} x \mathrm{e} ^ {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \mathrm{e} ^ {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} (a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}) = - \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {a} = \frac {1}{2} (\mathrm{e} ^ {a ^ {2}} - 1). \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x)=\int_{0}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{\cos t}dt$ ，则 $I=\int_{0}^{\pi}f(x)\cos x\mathrm{d}x=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \cos x   \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \mathrm{d} (\sin x) = f (x) \sin x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin x   \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 0 - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x} \sin x   \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x} \mathrm{d} (\cos x) = \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} - \mathrm{e}. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 曲线 $y = \frac{\sqrt{x}}{1 + x^2}$ 绕 $x$ 轴旋转一周所得的旋转体, 将它在 $x = 0$ 与 $x = \xi (\xi > 0)$ 之间部分的体积记为 $V(\xi)$ , 且 $V(a) = \frac{1}{2} \lim_{\xi \to +\infty} V(\xi)$ , 则 $a =$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 依题设,有
又
$$
\begin{array}{r l}&V (\xi) = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\xi} y ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\xi} \frac {x}{(1 + x ^ {2}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {\pi}{2} \left(- \frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {\xi} = \frac {\pi}{2} \left(1 - \frac {1}{1 + \xi^ {2}}\right).\\&\quad \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow + \infty} V (\xi) = \frac {\pi}{2}, V (a) = \frac {\pi}{2} \left(1 - \frac {1}{1 + a ^ {2}}\right),\end{array}
$$
由 $V(a) = \frac{1}{2}\lim_{\xi \to +\infty}V(\xi)$ ，得
$\frac{\pi}{2}\left(1-\frac{1}{1+a^{2}}\right)=\frac{\pi}{4}$ ，解得 $a=\pm1$ .
又 a > 0, 故 a = 1.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, +\infty)$ 上可导, $\ln (1 + x)$ 是 $f(x)$ 的一个原函数, 且 $F(x)=\lim_{t\to\infty}t^{2}\left[f\left(2x+\frac{1}{t}\right)-f(2x)\right]\sin\frac{x}{t}$ ，则 $F(x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上的平均值为 \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} F (x) & = \lim _ {t \to \infty} t ^ {2} \left[ f \left(2 x + \frac {1}{t}\right) - f (2 x) \right] \sin \frac {x}{t} \\ & = \lim _ {t \to \infty} \frac {x \sin \frac {x}{t}}{\frac {x}{t}} \cdot \frac {f \left(2 x + \frac {1}{t}\right) - f (2 x)}{\frac {1}{t}} = x f ^ {\prime} (2 x). \\ & \int f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \ln (1 + x) + C, \end{array}
$$
由已知，
故
$$
f (x) = \frac {1}{1 + x}.
$$
所求平均值为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \frac {1}{1 - 0} \int_ {0} ^ {1} F (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f ^ {\prime} (2 x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {x}{2} f (2 x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (2 x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} f (2) - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {2} f (t) \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {1}{6} - \frac {1}{4} \ln (1 + t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{6} - \frac {1}{4} \ln 3. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 曲线 $r = a \sin^{3} \frac{\theta}{3} (a > 0, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 3\pi)$ 的弧长 s = \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} s & = \int_ {0} ^ {3 \pi} \sqrt {r ^ {2} + r ^ {\prime 2}}   \mathrm{d} \theta = \int_ {0} ^ {3 \pi} \sqrt {a ^ {2} \sin^ {6} \frac {\theta}{3} + a ^ {2} \sin^ {4} \frac {\theta}{3} \cos^ {2} \frac {\theta}{3}}   \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & = a \int_ {0} ^ {3 \pi} \sin^ {2} \frac {\theta}{3}   \mathrm{d} \theta \stackrel {t = \frac {\theta}{3}} {=} 3 a \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {2} t   \mathrm{d} t = \frac {3 \pi a}{2}. \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 已知 $\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\sin x}{x}dx=\frac{\pi}{2}$ ，则 $I=\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\sin^{2}x}{x^{2}}dx=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
I = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\sin^ {2} x}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \sin^ {2} x \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) = - \frac {\sin^ {2} x}{x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {2 \sin x \cos x}{x} \mathrm{d} x
$$
$$
= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\sin 2 x}{x} \mathrm{d} x \stackrel {2 x = t} {=} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\sin t}{t} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {\pi}{2}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 曲线 $y=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{x}\sqrt{\cos t}dt$ 的全长 s= \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 函数 $y = \int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{x} \sqrt{\cos t} \, \mathrm{d}t$ 的定义域为 $\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ ，全长
$$
s = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {1 + y ^ {\prime 2}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {1 + \cos x} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {2} \cos \frac {x}{2} \mathrm{d} x = 4.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: $\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{x\ln x}{(1 + x^2)^2}\mathrm{d}x =$
questions.solution:
解 先求不定积分, 得原函数
故
$$
\begin{aligned} \int \frac{x \ln x}{(1 + x^2)^2} \mathrm{d}x & = -\frac{1}{2}\int \ln x \mathrm{d}\left(\frac{1}{1 + x^2}\right) = -\frac{\ln x}{2(1 + x^2)} + \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x(1 + x^2)} \\ & = -\frac{\ln x}{2(1 + x^2)} + \frac{1}{2}\int \left(\frac{1}{x} -\frac{x}{1 + x^2}\right)\mathrm{d}x = -\frac{\ln x}{2(1 + x^2)} + \frac{1}{4}\ln \frac{x^2}{1 + x^2} + C, \\ \int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{x \ln x}{(1 + x^2)^2} \mathrm{d}x & = \lim_{\substack{\varepsilon \to 0^+ \\ b\to +\infty}}\left[-\frac{\ln x}{2(1 + x^2)} + \frac{1}{4}\ln \frac{x^2}{1 + x^2}\right]\Big|_{\varepsilon}^{b}\\ & = \lim_{\substack{\varepsilon \to 0^+ \\ b\to +\infty}}\left[-\frac{\ln b}{2(1 + b^2)} + \frac{\ln\varepsilon}{2(1 + \varepsilon^2)} + \frac{1}{4}\ln \frac{b^2}{1 + b^2} - \frac{1}{4}\ln \frac{\varepsilon^2}{1 + \varepsilon^2}\right]\\ & = \lim_{\varepsilon \to 0^+}\left[-\frac{\varepsilon^2\ln\varepsilon}{2(1 + \varepsilon^2)} + \frac{1}{4}\ln (1 + \varepsilon^2)\right] = 0. \end{aligned}
$$
【注】这里 $\varepsilon \rightarrow 0^{+}, b \rightarrow +\infty$ 的取极限过程是独立的，分别求极限.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 由曲线 $y = \ln x$ 与两直线 $y = (e + 1) - x$ 及 $y = 0$ 所围平面图形的面积 $S =$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 如图 3-2 所示, 所围平面图形的面积为
$$
S = \int_ {0} ^ {1} [ (e + 1) - y - e ^ {y} ] d y = \frac {3}{2},
$$
或
$$
S = \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm{e}} \ln x \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\mathrm{e}} ^ {\mathrm{e} + 1} (\mathrm{e} + 1 - x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {3}{2}.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: $\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\ln \frac{x + 1}{x}\mathrm{d}x =$
questions.solution:
解 因为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln \frac {x + 1}{x} \mathrm{d} x & = \lim _ {b \to + \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln \frac {x + 1}{x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \lim _ {b \to + \infty} \left[ \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln (x + 1) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln x \mathrm{d} x \right], \end{array}
$$
其中
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln (x + 1) \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \sqrt {x} \ln (x + 1) \Big | _ {1} ^ {b} - 2 \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {\sqrt {x}}{x + 1} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \sqrt {b} \ln (b + 1) - 2 \ln 2 - (4 \sqrt {b} - 4 \arctan \sqrt {b} - 4 + \pi), \end{array}
$$
$$
\int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln x \mathrm{d} x = 2 \sqrt {x} \ln x \Big | _ {1} ^ {b} - 2 \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {\sqrt {x}}{x} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \sqrt {b} \ln b - 4 \sqrt {b} + 4,
$$
故
$$
\int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln \frac {x + 1}{x} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \left(2 \sqrt {b} \ln \frac {b + 1}{b} + 4 \arctan \sqrt {b} - 2 \ln 2 - \pi\right) = \pi - 2 \ln 2.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 D 是由曲线 $y = \sin x + 1$ 与直线 $x = 0, x = \pi, y = 0$ 所围平面图形，则 D 绕 x 轴旋转一周所得旋转体的体积 V = \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 如图 3-3 所示,所得旋转体的体积为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} V & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \pi (\sin x + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \left(1 + 2 \sin x + \frac {1 - \cos 2 x}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \pi \left(\frac {3}{2} x - 2 \cos x - \frac {1}{4} \sin 2 x\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} \\ & = \frac {3}{2} \pi^ {2} + 4 \pi . \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: $\lim_{x\to0^{+}}\frac{1}{\ln\frac{1}{x}}\int_{x}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-t}}{t}dt=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 由 $\lim_{x\to +\infty}x^2\cdot \frac{\mathrm{e}^{-x}}{x} = \lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{x}{\mathrm{e}^x} = 0$ ，知 $\int_{a}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-t}}{t}\mathrm{d}t$ 收敛 $(a > 0)$ .从而
$\int_{a}^{+\infty}\frac{e^{-t}}{t}dt=C(常数),\quad 故\lim_{x\to0^{+}}\frac{\int_{a}^{+\infty}\frac{e^{-t}}{t}dt}{\ln\frac{1}{x}}=0.$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {1}{\ln \frac {1}{x}} \int_ {x} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {\int_ {x} ^ {a} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {a} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\ln \frac {1}{x}}} \\ & {\qquad = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {\int_ {x} ^ {a} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\ln \frac {1}{x}} \frac {\text {洛必达}}{\text {法则}} \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {- \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{x}}{- \frac {1}{x}} = 1.} \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $n$ 为正数， $\lim_{x \to 0} \left( \frac{n - x}{n + x} \right)^{\frac{2}{x}} = \int_{\frac{1}{n}}^{+\infty} x e^{-4x} dx$ ，则 $n = \_$ .
questions.solution:
解 依题设,有
$$
\lim _ {x \to 0} \left(\frac {n - x}{n + x}\right) ^ {\frac {2}{x}} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \left[ \left(1 - \frac {2 x}{n + x}\right) ^ {\frac {- (n + x)}{2 x}} \right] ^ {\frac {- 4}{n + x}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {4}{n}},
$$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {\frac {1}{n}} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm{e} ^ {- 4 x} \mathrm{d} x & = - \frac {1}{4} x \mathrm{e} ^ {- 4 x} \Big | _ {\frac {1}{n}} ^ {+ \infty} + \frac {1}{4} \int_ {\frac {1}{n}} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 4 x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {1}{4 n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {4}{n}} - \frac {1}{1 6} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 4 x} \Big | _ {\frac {1}{n}} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {1}{4 n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {4}{n}} + \frac {1}{1 6} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {4}{n}}, \end{array}
$$
故
$\left(\frac{1}{4n} + \frac{1}{16}\right)\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{4}{n}} = \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{4}{n}}$ ，解得 $n = \frac{4}{15}$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: $\int_{1}^{2}\left[\frac{1}{x\ln^2x} -\frac{1}{(x - 1)^2}\right]\mathrm{d}x =$
questions.solution:
解 x = 1 是奇点.
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {1} ^ {2} \left[ \frac {1}{x \ln^ {2} x} - \frac {1}{(x - 1) ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm{d} x & = \left(- \frac {1}{\ln x} + \frac {1}{x - 1}\right) \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {2} \\ & = \left(- \frac {1}{\ln 2} + 1\right) - \lim _ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \left(- \frac {1}{\ln x} + \frac {1}{x - 1}\right) \\ & = 1 - \frac {1}{\ln 2} - \lim _ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) \ln x}, \end{array}
$$
而
$$
\lim _ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) \ln x} = \lim _ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {1}{x} - 1}{\ln x + \frac {x - 1}{x}} = \lim _ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {- \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}{\frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = - \frac {1}{2},
$$
故
$$
\mathrm{原积分} = 1 - \frac {1}{\ln 2} + \frac {1}{2} = \frac {3}{2} - \frac {1}{\ln 2}.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设在 $x$ 轴的区间 $[0,1]$ 上有一根长度为 1 的细棒, 若其线密度 $\rho(x)=2x+1$ , 则该细棒的质心坐标 $\bar{x}=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 由细棒的质心坐标公式, 得
$$
\overline {{x}} = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} x \rho (x) \mathrm{d} x}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} \rho (x) \mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} x (2 x + 1) \mathrm{d} x}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} (2 x + 1) \mathrm{d} x} = \frac {7}{1 2}.
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x)$ 满足 $\int_{0}^{x} f(t - x) dt = x + \frac{1}{2} x^{2} + \ln |1 - x|$ ，则 $y = f(x)$ 的斜渐近线方程为 \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解 由 $\int_{0}^{x} f(t - x) \, \mathrm{d}t \stackrel{t - x = u}{=} \int_{-x}^{0} f(u) \, \mathrm{d}u$ ，得
$$
\int_ {- x} ^ {0} f (u) \mathrm{d} u = x + \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + \ln | 1 - x |.
$$
上式两边对 x 求导, 得
$$
f (- x) = 1 + x + \frac {- 1}{1 - x} = \frac {- x ^ {2}}{1 - x},
$$
故
$$
f (x) = \frac {- x ^ {2}}{1 + x}.
$$
由 $\lim_{x\to \infty}\frac{f(x)}{x} = -1,\lim_{x\to \infty}[f(x) + x] = 1$ ，知 $y = f(x)$ 的斜渐近线方程为 $y = -x + 1.$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 极限 $\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{1}{n}\ln\frac{n+2k}{3n-2k}=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\underset {n \to \infty} {\lim} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{n} \ln \frac {n + 2 k}{3 n - 2 k} = \underset {n \to \infty} {\lim} \frac {1}{2} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \frac {2 - 0}{n} \ln \frac {1 + \frac {2 k}{n}}{3 - \frac {2 k}{n}} = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2} \ln \frac {1 + x}{3 - x} \mathrm{d} x} \\ & \qquad \underline {{{{\underline {{{{x = 1 + t}}}}}}} \frac {1}{2} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \ln \frac {2 + t}{2 - t} \mathrm{d} t.} \end{array}
$$
因 $\ln\frac{2+t}{2-t}$ 为奇函数, 故原式 =0.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(t)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{t-1}{[n+(t-1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t-1}{n}i}}(t>1)$ ，则 $\lim_{t\to+\infty}f(t)=$ \_\_\_\_.
questions.solution:
解
$$
\begin{array}{r l} f (t) & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {t - 1}{[ n + (t - 1) i ] \sqrt {\frac {t - 1}{n} i}} \\ & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {t - 1}{n \left(1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i - 1}} \\ & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {t - 1}{n}}{\left(1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i - 1}} = \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}}, \end{array}
$$
故
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \lim _ {t \to + \infty} f (t) & = \lim _ {t \to + \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}} \\ & = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}} = \int_ {1} ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}} + \int_ {2} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}} \\ & = \lim _ {\xi \to 0 ^ {+}} \int_ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} + \lim _ {b \to + \infty} \int_ {2} ^ {b} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} \\ & = \lim _ {\xi \to 0 ^ {+}} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \left| _ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} + \lim _ {b \to + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \right| _ {2} ^ {b} \end{array}
$$
$$
\begin{array}{l}= \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - 2 \arctan \sqrt {\xi}\right) + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {b - 1} - \frac {\pi}{2}\\= \frac {\pi}{2} - 0 + \pi - \frac {\pi}{2} = \pi .\end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设质点以速度 $\sqrt{t}e^{-\sqrt{t}}(t\geqslant0)m/s$ 作直线运动，则质点从开始运动到停止运动经过的路程为 m，它在 t=0 到 t=4s 时间段内的平均速度为 \_\_\_\_m/s.
questions.solution:
解 依题设,所求路程为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} s & = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \sqrt {t} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \sqrt {t}} \mathrm{d} t \xlongequal {\sqrt {t} = u} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} u \mathrm{e} ^ {- u} \cdot 2 u \mathrm{d} u = - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {- u}) \\ & = - 2 \left(u ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- u} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 u \mathrm{e} ^ {- u} \mathrm{d} u\right) = - 4 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} u \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {- u}) \\ & = - 4 \left(u \mathrm{e} ^ {- u} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- u} \mathrm{d} u\right) = - 4 \mathrm{e} ^ {- u} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = 4 (\mathrm{m}), \end{array}
$$
所求平均速度为
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \overline {{v}} & = \frac {1}{4 - 0} \int_ {0} ^ {4} \sqrt {t} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \sqrt {t}} \mathrm{d} t \xlongequal {- \sqrt {t} = u} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {- 2} u ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \mathrm{d} u = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {- 2} ^ {0} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {u}) \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \left(u ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \Big | _ {- 2} ^ {0} - 2 \int_ {- 2} ^ {0} u \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \mathrm{d} u\right) \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \left[ - 4 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2} - 2 \int_ {- 2} ^ {0} u \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {u}) \right] \\ & = - 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2} - \left(u \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \Big | _ {- 2} ^ {0} - \int_ {- 2} ^ {0} \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \mathrm{d} u\right) \\ & = - 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2} - 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2} + \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \Big | _ {- 2} ^ {0} \\ & = 1 - 5 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2} (\mathrm{m/s}). \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
求下列积分:
(I) $\int\frac{2^{x}\cdot3^{x}}{9^{x}-4^{x}}dx;$
$(II)\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^2(1 - x^4)};$
(III) $\int\frac{dx}{x^{4}(1+x^{2})}$ ;
$(IV)\int \frac{\arctan x}{x^2(1 + x^2)}\mathrm{d}x;$
(V) $\int\frac{x+\ln(1-x)}{x^{2}}dx.$
questions.solution:
$$
 egin{array}{r l} 	ext {(1) 解 (I)} & \int  rac {2 ^ {x} \cdot 3 ^ {x}}{9 ^ {x} - 4 ^ {x}} \mathrm{d} x = \int  rac {6 ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x}{4 ^ {x} \left[ \left( rac {9}{4}ight) ^ {x} - 1 ight]} = \int  rac {\left( rac {3}{2}ight) ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x}{\left[ \left( rac {3}{2}ight) ^ {x} ight] ^ {2} - 1} \ & =  rac {1}{\ln  rac {3}{2}} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} \left[ \left( rac {3}{2}ight) ^ {x} ight]}{\left[ \left( rac {3}{2}ight) ^ {x} ight] ^ {2} - 1} =  rac {1}{2 \ln  rac {3}{2}} \ln \left|  rac {3 ^ {x} - 2 ^ {x}}{3 ^ {x} + 2 ^ {x}} ight| + C. \end{array}
$$
【注】 $\int  rac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^2 - 1} =  rac{1}{2}\ln \left| rac{x - 1}{x + 1}ight| + C.$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} 	ext {(II)} & \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {2} (1 - x ^ {4})} = \int  rac {x ^ {2}}{x ^ {4} (1 - x ^ {4})} \mathrm{d} x = \int x ^ {2} \left( rac {1}{x ^ {4}} +  rac {1}{1 - x ^ {4}}ight) \mathrm{d} x \ & = \int  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + \int  rac {1 + x ^ {2} - 1}{1 - x ^ {4}} \mathrm{d} x = -  rac {1}{x} + \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 - x ^ {2}} - \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 - x ^ {4}} \ & = -  rac {1}{x} + \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 - x ^ {2}} -  rac {1}{2} \int \left( rac {1}{1 - x ^ {2}} +  rac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}}ight) \mathrm{d} x \ & = -  rac {1}{x} +  rac {1}{2} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 - x ^ {2}} -  rac {1}{2} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \ & = -  rac {1}{x} +  rac {1}{4} \ln \left|  rac {1 + x}{1 - x} ight| -  rac {1}{2} \arctan x + C. \end{array}
$$
（Ⅲ）利用倒代换，令 $x =  rac{1}{t}$ ，则
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {4} (1 + x ^ {2})} & = - \int  rac {t ^ {4}}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = - \int  rac {t ^ {4} - 1 + 1}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = - \int (t ^ {2} - 1) \mathrm{d} t - \int  rac {\mathrm{d} t}{1 + t ^ {2}} \ & = -  rac {1}{3} t ^ {3} + t - \arctan t + C = -  rac {1}{3 x ^ {3}} +  rac {1}{x} - \arctan  rac {1}{x} + C. \end{array}
$$
(Ⅳ) 考虑到 $ rac{1}{x^2(1 + x^2)} =  rac{1}{x^2} -  rac{1}{1 + x^2}$ , 故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\arctan x}{x ^ {2} (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {\arctan x}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x - \int  rac {\arctan x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \ & = - \int \arctan x \mathrm{d} \left( rac {1}{x}ight) - \int \arctan x \mathrm{d} (\arctan x) \ & = -  rac {\arctan x}{x} + \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{x (1 + x ^ {2})} -  rac {1}{2} (\arctan x) ^ {2} \ & = -  rac {\arctan x}{x} +  rac {1}{2} \int \left( rac {1}{x ^ {2}} -  rac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}}ight) \mathrm{d} (x ^ {2}) -  rac {1}{2} (\arctan x) ^ {2} \ & = -  rac {\arctan x}{x} -  rac {1}{2} (\arctan x) ^ {2} +  rac {1}{2} \ln  rac {x ^ {2}}{1 + x ^ {2}} + C. \end{array}
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {x + \ln (1 - x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{x} + \int  rac {\ln (1 - x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \ln | x | - \int \ln (1 - x) \mathrm{d} \left( rac {1}{x}ight) \ & = \ln | x | -  rac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} - \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{x (1 - x)} \ & = \ln | x | -  rac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} - \int \left( rac {1}{x} +  rac {1}{1 - x}ight) \mathrm{d} x \ & = \left(1 -  rac {1}{x}ight) \ln (1 - x) + C. \end{array} 	ag {V}

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $y = f(x)$ 在 $[0, +\infty)$ 上非负连续，曲边梯形 $D(t) = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant t, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant f(x)\}$ ， $D(t)$ 所围图形的面积 $S(t) = te^{t}, D(t)$ 绕直线 x = t 旋转一周所得旋转体的体积为 $V(t)$ ，求 $V(t)$ 的表达式.
questions.solution:
(1) 解 用微元法求 $V(t)$ .
任取 $[x,x+\mathrm{d}x]\subset[0,t]$ ，如图3-29所示，则 $\mathrm{d}V=2\pi(t-x)f(x)\mathrm{d}x$ .
由于 $V(t)=\int_{0}^{t}2\pi(t-x)f(x)\mathrm{d}x$ ,
$$
\begin{array}{r l} V ^ {\prime} (t) & = 2 \pi \left[ t \int_ {0} ^ {t} f (x) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {t} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right] ^ {\prime} \\ & = 2 \pi \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {t} f (x) \mathrm{d} x + t f (t) - t f (t) \right] \\ & = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {t} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi S (t) = 2 \pi t \mathrm{e} ^ {t}, \\ V (t) & = 2 \pi \int t \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \mathrm{d} t = 2 \pi (t - 1) \mathrm{e} ^ {t} + C. \end{array}
$$
![](images/93e1c332bf20017e596efee78abe4915f69ac3a33e1c55d0f77b3a27e7b7c8f4.jpg)  
图3-29
故
又由 $V(0)=0$ ，得 $C=2\pi$ ，由此可知 $V(t)=2\pi(t-1)\mathrm{e}^{t}+2\pi.$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
求下列积分:
(I) 设 $f(x)=\int_{1}^{x}\frac{dt}{\sqrt{1+t^{4}}}$ ，求 $I=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}f(x)\mathrm{d}x;$
(II) 设 $f(x) = \int_{1}^{x^2} \mathrm{e}^{-t^2} dt$ , 求 $I = \int_{0}^{1} x f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
questions.solution:
解 (I) $I=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}f(x)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{x^{3}}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{3}x^{3}f(x)\Big|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{3}\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x^{3}\mathrm{d}x}{\sqrt{1+x^{4}}}=-\frac{1}{6}(1+x^{4})^{\frac{1}{2}}\Big|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{6}(1-\sqrt{2})$.
(II) $I=\int_{0}^{1}xf(x)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\mathrm{d}(x^{2})=\frac{1}{2}x^{2}f(x)\Big|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}f^{\prime}(x)\mathrm{d}x=-\int_{0}^{1}x^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{4}}\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{4}}\Big|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{4}(\mathrm{e}^{-1}-1)$，这里 $f(1)=0$.
【注】积分 $\int\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\sqrt{1+x^4}},\int\mathrm{e}^{\pm x^2}\mathrm{d}x,\int\frac{\sin x}{x}\mathrm{d}x,\int\frac{\cos x}{x}\mathrm{d}x$ 俗称“积不出来”，即原函数不能用初等函数表达.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
求下列积分:
(I) $\int\frac{dx}{x(1+\sqrt{x})}$ ;
(II) $\int\frac{xe^{x}}{\sqrt{e^{x}-1}}dx;$
$$
(I I I) \int \frac {x ^ {3}}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x;
$$
$(IV)\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(2x^2 + 1)\sqrt{1 + x^2}};$
(V) $\int\frac{\arctan\sqrt{x-1}}{x\sqrt{x-1}}dx;$
(VI) $\int\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-x\sqrt{x}}}dx.$
questions.solution:
(2) 解 (Ⅰ) 令 $\sqrt{x} = t$ , 则 $x = t^2$ , 故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{x (1 + \sqrt {x})} & = \int  rac {2 t \mathrm{d} t}{t ^ {2} (1 + t)} = 2 \int  rac {\mathrm{d} t}{t (1 + t)} = 2 \int \left( rac {1}{t} -  rac {1}{1 + t}ight) \mathrm{d} t \ & = 2 [ \ln t - \ln (1 + t) ] + C \ & = 2 [ \ln \sqrt {x} - \ln (1 + \sqrt {x}) ] + C = 2 \ln  rac {\sqrt {x}}{1 + \sqrt {x}} + C. \end{array}
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{\sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1}} \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \int x \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1}) = 2 \left(x \sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1} - \int \sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1} \mathrm{d} xight) \ & = 2 x \sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1} - 2 \int \sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1} \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}
$$
令 $\sqrt{\mathrm{e}^x - 1} = t$ ，则 $x = \ln (1 + t^2),\mathrm{d}x =  rac{2t}{1 + t^2}\mathrm{d}t$ ，故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int \sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {2 t ^ {2}}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = 2 \int  rac {t ^ {2} + 1 - 1}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t \ & = 2 t - 2 \int  rac {\mathrm{d} t}{1 + t ^ {2}} = 2 t - 2 \arctan t + C. \end{array}
$$
所以
原式 $= 2x\sqrt{\mathrm{e}^x - 1} -4\sqrt{\mathrm{e}^x - 1} +4\arctan \sqrt{\mathrm{e}^x - 1} +C.$
（Ⅲ）令 $x = 	an t, t \in \left(- rac{\pi}{2},  rac{\pi}{2}ight)$ ，则 $\mathrm{d}x = \sec^2 t \mathrm{d}t$ ，故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {x ^ {3}}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {	an^ {3} t \cdot \sec^ {2} t}{\sec t} \mathrm{d} t = \int 	an^ {2} t \mathrm{d} (\sec t) \ & = \int (\sec^ {2} t - 1) \mathrm{d} (\sec t) =  rac {1}{3} \sec^ {3} t - \sec t + C. \end{array}
$$
如图3-4所示， $\sec t = \sqrt{1 + x^2}$ ，于是原式
![](images/58a9adb0f46788c0e1d165995573685afbf84e9ac40f526b9b7bdebb6a6627ef.jpg)
$$
\int  rac {x ^ {3}}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x =  rac {1}{3} (1 + x ^ {2}) ^ { rac {3}{2}} - (1 + x ^ {2}) ^ { rac {1}{2}} + C.
$$
图3-4
【注】此题也可凑微分.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {x ^ {3}}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {x ^ {2} \cdot \mathrm{d} (1 + x ^ {2})}{2 \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} = \int (x ^ {2} + 1 - 1) \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) \ & = \int (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 1}) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) - \int \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) \ & =  rac {1}{3} (1 + x ^ {2}) ^ { rac {3}{2}} - (1 + x ^ {2}) ^ { rac {1}{2}} + C. \end{array}
$$
(Ⅳ) 令 $	an t = x$ ，则 $\mathrm{d}x = \sec^2 t\mathrm{d}t$ ，故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x ^ {2} + 1) \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} & = \int  rac {\mathrm{d} t}{(2 	an^ {2} t + 1) \cos t} = \int  rac {\cos t \mathrm{d} t}{2 \sin^ {2} t + \cos^ {2} t} \ & = \int  rac {\mathrm{d} (\sin t)}{1 + \sin^ {2} t} = \arctan (\sin t) + C. \end{array}
$$
又 $\sin t =  rac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}$ ，故
$$
	ext { 原式 } = \arctan { rac {x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}}} + C.
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}}{x \sqrt {x - 1}} \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \int  rac {\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}}{x} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1}) \ & = 2 \int  rac {\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1}) \ & = 2 \int \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \mathrm{d} (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) \ & = (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2} + C. \end{array} 	ag {V}
$$
(VI)
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int \sqrt { rac {x}{1 - x \sqrt {x}}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {\sqrt {x}}{\sqrt {1 - x \sqrt {x}}} \mathrm{d} x =  rac {2}{3} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} \left(x ^ { rac {3}{2}}ight)}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ { rac {3}{2}}}} = -  rac {2}{3} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} \left(1 - x ^ { rac {3}{2}}ight)}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ { rac {3}{2}}}} \ & = -  rac {2}{3} \cdot 2 \int \mathrm{d} \left(\sqrt {1 - x ^ { rac {3}{2}}}ight) = -  rac {4}{3} \sqrt {1 - x \sqrt {x}} + C. \end{array}

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
如图 (a) 所示，在水平放置的椭圆底柱形容器内存放液体，密度为 $\rho$ (单位: $\mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{m}^{3}$ )，容器长为 $4m$ ，椭圆方程为 $\frac{x^{2}}{4} + y^{2} = 1$ (单位: $m$ ), 即如图 (b) 所示.
![](images/966d66edf0e71a94839c0928b0851da6421979d79f1a6ba3146193e8c5884b09.jpg)  
(a)
![](images/7a24dbcafd675f0f543e49987c3d939ce1e0d3829afef68076da16bfef3f2952.jpg)  
(b)
(I) 当液面在过点 $(0, y)(-1 \leqslant y \leqslant 1)$ 处的水平线时, 容器内液体的体积是多少?
(II) 当容器内存满了液体后, 平均每分钟从容器顶端抽出 $0.16m^{3}$ 的液体, 当液面降至 y=0 处时, 求液体下降的速度.
(III) 问抽出全部液体需要做多少功?
questions.solution:
$$
\begin{array}{r l} (I) V & = 4 \cdot 2 \int_ {- 1} ^ {y} 2 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y \xlongequal {y = \sin t} 1 6 \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\arcsin y} \cos^ {2} t \mathrm{d} t \\ & = 8 \arcsin y + 8 y \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} + 4 \pi (\mathrm{m} ^ {3}). \end{array}
$$
（Ⅱ）由于 $\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}y}\cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = 16\sqrt{1 - y^2}\cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}$ 故
$$
\left. \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \right| _ {y = 0} = \frac {1}{1 6 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} \cdot \left. \frac {\mathrm{d} V}{\mathrm{d} t} \right| _ {y = 0} = \frac {1}{1 6} \times 0. 1 6 = 0. 0 1 (\mathrm{m/min}).
$$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} W & = 4 \rho g \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} 4 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \cdot (1 - y) \mathrm{d} y = 4 \rho g \left(\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} 4 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y - \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} 4 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \cdot y \mathrm{d} y\right) \\ & = 4 \rho g \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} 4 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y - 0 = 8 \rho g \pi (\mathrm{J}). \end{array}
$$

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(\sin^2 x) = \frac{x}{\sin x}$ ，求 $I = \int \frac{\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1 - x}} f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
questions.solution: 解 令 $\sin^2 x=t$，则 $\sin x=\pm\sqrt{t}$. 由 $\sqrt{x}\geqslant 0,\sqrt{1-x}\geqslant 0$，知 $x\geqslant 0,1-x\geqslant 0$，故 $0\leqslant x\leqslant 1$，所以 $\sin x\geqslant 0$. 取 $\sin x=\sqrt{t}$，则 $x=\arcsin\sqrt{t},f(t)=\frac{\arcsin\sqrt{t}}{\sqrt{t}}$，故 $I=\int\frac{\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1-x}}f(x)\mathrm{d}x=\int\frac{\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1-x}}\cdot\frac{\arcsin\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{x}}\mathrm{d}x=-\int\frac{\arcsin\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1-x}}\mathrm{d}(1-x)=-2\int\arcsin\sqrt{x}\ \mathrm{d}(\sqrt{1-x})=-2\sqrt{1-x}\arcsin\sqrt{x}+2\int\sqrt{1-x}\ \mathrm{d}(\arcsin\sqrt{x})=-2\sqrt{1-x}\arcsin\sqrt{x}+2\sqrt{x}+C$.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
求下列积分:
(I) $\int\frac{dx}{\sin^{2}x\cos^{4}x};$
$(II)\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{1 + \sin x};$
(III) $\int\frac{\sin x}{\sin x+\cos x}dx;$
$(IV)\int \frac{3\sin x + \cos x}{\sin x + 2\cos x}\mathrm{d}x;$
(V) $\int\frac{dx}{\sin2x+2\sin x};$
$$
(V I) \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{a ^ {2} \sin^ {2} x + b ^ {2} \cos^ {2} x} (a ^ {2} + b ^ {2} > 0).
$$
questions.solution:
$$
 egin{array}{r l} (3) 	ext {解(I)} & = \int  rac {1}{\sin^ {2} x \cos^ {4} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int  rac {(\sin^ {2} x + \cos^ {2} x) ^ {2}}{\sin^ {2} x \cos^ {4} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \left( rac {\sin^ {2} x}{\cos^ {4} x} +  rac {2}{\cos^ {2} x} +  rac {1}{\sin^ {2} x}ight) \mathrm{d} x \ & = \int 	an^ {2} x   \mathrm{d} (	an x) + 2 	an x - \cot x \ & =  rac {1}{3} 	an^ {3} x + 2 	an x - \cot x + C. \end{array}
$$
【注】求解三角有理式积分首先考虑利用恒等变形、三角公式,一般的方法是利用万能代换.此题也可以分子、分母同乘以 $\cos^{2}x$ , 得
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {1}{\sin^ {2} x \cos^ {4} x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {1}{	an^ {2} x \cos^ {6} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int  rac {\sec^ {4} x}{	an^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} (	an x) \ & = \int  rac {	an^ {4} x + 2 	an^ {2} x + 1}{	an^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} (	an x) =  rac {1}{3} 	an^ {3} x + 2 	an x - \cot x + C. \end{array}
$$
（Ⅱ）分子、分母同时乘以 $(1-\sin x)$ ，再凑微分.
$$
\int  rac {1}{1 + \sin x} \mathrm{d} x = \int  rac {1 - \sin x}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int  rac {1}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} x + \int  rac {1}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} (\cos x) = 	an x -  rac {1}{\cos x} + C.
$$
【注】 利用三角公式.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {1}{1 + \sin x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {1}{1 + 2 \sin  rac {x}{2} \cos  rac {x}{2}} \mathrm{d} x = \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\left(\sin  rac {x}{2} + \cos  rac {x}{2}ight) ^ {2}} \ & = \int  rac {\sec^ {2}  rac {x}{2}}{\left(1 + 	an  rac {x}{2}ight) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int  rac {\mathrm{d} \left(	an  rac {x}{2}ight)}{\left(1 + 	an  rac {x}{2}ight) ^ {2}} = -  rac {2}{1 + 	an  rac {x}{2}} + C. \end{array}
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} (	ext {Ⅲ}) \int  rac {\sin x}{\sin x + \cos x} \mathrm{d} x & =  rac {1}{2} \int  rac {(\sin x + \cos x) + (\sin x - \cos x)}{\sin x + \cos x} \mathrm{d} x \ & =  rac {1}{2} \int \mathrm{d} x -  rac {1}{2} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} (\sin x + \cos x)}{\sin x + \cos x} \ & =  rac {1}{2} x -  rac {1}{2} \ln | \sin x + \cos x | + C. \end{array}
$$
【注】 这里利用了
$$
f (x) =  rac {f (x) + f (- x)}{2} +  rac {f (x) - f (- x)}{2},
$$
即 $f(x)$ 可以表示成一个偶函数与一个奇函数之和.
(Ⅳ) 考虑拆项凑微分. 令
$$
3 \sin x + \cos x = A (\sin x + 2 \cos x) + B (\cos x - 2 \sin x),
$$
比较两边系数,可得 A = 1, B = -1, 故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {3 \sin x + \cos x}{\sin x + 2 \cos x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int  rac {(\sin x + 2 \cos x) - (\cos x - 2 \sin x)}{\sin x + 2 \cos x} \mathrm{d} x \ & = \int \mathrm{d} x - \int  rac {\mathrm{d} (\sin x + 2 \cos x)}{\sin x + 2 \cos x} \ & = x - \ln | \sin x + 2 \cos x | + C. \end{array}
$$
（V）用万能代换，令 $	an  rac{x}{2} = t$ ，则 $\sin x =  rac{2t}{1 + t^2},\cos x =  rac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2},\mathrm{d}x =  rac{2\mathrm{d}t}{1 + t^2}$ 故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sin 2 x + 2 \sin x} & = \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{2 \sin x \cos x + 2 \sin x} = \int  rac { rac {2 \mathrm{d} t}{1 + t ^ {2}}}{2 \cdot  rac {2 t}{1 + t ^ {2}} \cdot  rac {1 - t ^ {2}}{1 + t ^ {2}} + 2 \cdot  rac {2 t}{1 + t ^ {2}}} \ & =  rac {1}{4} \int  rac {1 + t ^ {2}}{t} \mathrm{d} t =  rac {1}{4} \int  rac {1}{t} \mathrm{d} t +  rac {1}{4} \int t \mathrm{d} t \ & =  rac {1}{4} \ln | t | +  rac {1}{8} t ^ {2} + C \ & =  rac {1}{4} \ln \left| 	an  rac {x}{2} ight| +  rac {1}{8} 	an^ {2}  rac {x}{2} + C. \end{array}
$$
(VI) 当 $a = 0, b 
eq 0$ 时， $\int  rac{\mathrm{d}x}{a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x} = \int  rac{\mathrm{d}x}{b^2 \cos^2 x} =  rac{1}{b^2} 	an x + C;$
当 $a 
eq 0, b = 0$ 时， $\int  rac{\mathrm{d}x}{a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x} = \int  rac{\mathrm{d}x}{a^2 \sin^2 x} = - rac{1}{a^2} \cot x + C;$
当 $a 
eq 0$ 且 $b 
eq 0$ 时，
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{a ^ {2} \sin^ {2} x + b ^ {2} \cos^ {2} x} & = \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{b ^ {2} \cos^ {2} x \left(1 +  rac {a ^ {2}}{b ^ {2}} 	an^ {2} xight)} \ & = \int  rac {1}{a b}  rac {1}{1 + \left( rac {a}{b} 	an xight) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} \left( rac {a}{b} 	an xight) \ & =  rac {1}{a b} \arctan \left( rac {a}{b} 	an xight) + C. \end{array}

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
设 $f(x)$ 在 $[a, b]$ 上有二阶导数, 且 $f(a) = f(b) = 0, f''(x) < 0$ , 证明: 当 $x \in (a, b)$ 时, 有
$$
0 <   f (x) <   \frac {2}{b - a} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x.
$$
questions.solution:
(3) 证 先证 $f(x) > 0$ .
由 $f(a)=f(b)=0$ 及罗尔定理，知存在 $x_{0}\in(a,b)$ ，使得 $f'(x_{0})=0$ 。由 $f''(x)<0$ ，知 $f'(x)$ 单调递减，则当 $x\in(a,x_{0})$ 时， $f'(x)>f'(x_{0})=0$ ，即 $f(x)$ 单调递增，故 $f(x)>f(a)=0$ ；当 $x\in(x_{0},b)$ 时， $f'(x)<f'(x_{0})=0$ ，即 $f(x)$ 单调递减，故 $f(x)>f(b)=0$ 。
综上所述，当 $x\in(a,b)$ 时， $f(x)>0$ .
再证 $f(x) < \frac{2}{b - a}\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x.$
应用泰勒公式, 将 $f(x)$ 在 $x = t \in (a, b)$ 处展开, 有
$f(x) = f(t) + f'(t)(x - t) + \frac{f''(\xi)}{2!} (x - t)^2,\xi$ 介于 $x$ 与 $t$ 之间.
由 $f''(x) < 0$ ，知 $f''(\xi) < 0$ ，故
$$
f (x) <   f (t) + f ^ {\prime} (t) (x - t).
$$
在 $[a,b]$ 上，上式两边同时对t积分，得
$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} t <   \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (t) \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime} (t) (x - t) \mathrm{d} t,
$$
即
$$
(b - a) f (x) <   \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (t) \mathrm{d} t + (x - t) f (t) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} + \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (t) \mathrm{d} t, = 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (t) \mathrm{d} t,
$$
故 $f(x) < \frac{2}{b - a}\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x.$ 所证不等式成立.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 计算积分 $I=\int e^{\sin x}\cdot\frac{x\cos^{3}x-\sin x}{\cos^{2}x}dx.$
questions.solution: 解 $I=\int\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\left(x\cos x-\frac{\sin x}{\cos^{2}x}\right)\mathrm{d}x=\int x\cos x\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\mathrm{d}x-\int\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\cdot\frac{\sin x}{\cos^{2}x}\mathrm{d}x=\int x\mathrm{d}(\mathrm{e}^{\sin x})+\int\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\mathrm{d}\left(-\frac{1}{\cos x}\right)=x\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}-\int\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\mathrm{d}x-\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}}{\cos x}+\int\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\cos x\cdot\frac{1}{\cos x}\mathrm{d}x=x\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}-\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}}{\cos x}+C$.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
求下列积分:
(I) $\int\arctan\sqrt{x}dx;$
$(II)\int \frac{\ln x}{(1 - x)^{2}}\mathrm{d}x;$
$$
(I I I) \int \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{(x + 2) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x;
$$
$(IV)\int \sin (\ln x)\mathrm{d}x;$
(V) $\int\frac{1}{x^{2}}\sqrt{\frac{1-x}{1+x}}dx;$
$(VI)\int \mathrm{e}^{2x}(1 + \tan x)^{2}\mathrm{d}x.$
questions.solution:
(4) 解（I）用分部积分法.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int \arctan \sqrt {x} \mathrm{d} x & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \int x \cdot  rac {1}{1 + x} \cdot  rac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \mathrm{d} x \ & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} -  rac {1}{2} \int  rac {x + 1 - 1}{\sqrt {x} (1 + x)} \mathrm{d} x \ & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \int  rac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \mathrm{d} x + \int  rac {\mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x})}{1 + (\sqrt {x}) ^ {2}} \ & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \sqrt {x} + \arctan \sqrt {x} + C. \end{array}
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {\ln x}{(1 - x) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x & = - \int \ln x \mathrm{d} \left( rac {1}{x - 1}ight) = -  rac {\ln x}{x - 1} + \int  rac {1}{x - 1} \cdot  rac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x \ & = -  rac {\ln x}{x - 1} + \int \left( rac {1}{x - 1} -  rac {1}{x}ight) \mathrm{d} x \ & = -  rac {\ln x}{x - 1} + \ln | x - 1 | - \ln x + C. \end{array}
$$
(Ⅲ) $\int  rac{x^2\mathrm{e}^x}{(x + 2)^2}\mathrm{d}x = -\int x^2\mathrm{e}^xd\left( rac{1}{x + 2}ight) = -x^2\mathrm{e}^x\cdot  rac{1}{x + 2} +\int  rac{1}{x + 2}\mathrm{d}(x^2\mathrm{e}^x)$
$$
 egin{array}{l} = -  rac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + \int  rac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + 2 x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} \mathrm{d} x = -  rac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + \int x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x \ = -  rac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} - \int \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x = -  rac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} - \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C. \end{array}
$$
(Ⅳ) 令 $\ln x = t$ ，则 $x = e^{t}$ ， $dx = e^{t}dt$ .
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int \sin (\ln x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int \sin t \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \mathrm{d} t = \int \sin t \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {t}) = \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \int \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cos t \mathrm{d} t \ & = \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \int \cos t \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {t}) = \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cos t + \int \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t \mathrm{d} tight), \end{array}
$$
设 $I = \int \mathrm{e}^{t}\sin t\mathrm{d}t$ ，则 $I = \mathrm{e}^t\sin t - \mathrm{e}^t\cos t - I$ ，即
$$
I =  rac {1}{2} (\mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cos t) + C =  rac {1}{2} x [ \sin (\ln x) - \cos (\ln x) ] + C.
$$
(V) 令 $\sqrt{ rac{1 - x}{1 + x}} = t$ ，则 $x =  rac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}, \mathrm{d}x = - rac{4t}{(1 + t^2)^2} \mathrm{d}t$ ，故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} \sqrt { rac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \mathrm{d} x & = - \int  rac {4 t ^ {2}}{(1 - t ^ {2}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = - 2 \int  rac {t \mathrm{d} (t ^ {2})}{(1 - t ^ {2}) ^ {2}} = - 2 \int t \mathrm{d} \left( rac {1}{1 - t ^ {2}}ight) \ & = -  rac {2 t}{1 - t ^ {2}} + 2 \int  rac {1}{1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = -  rac {2 t}{1 - t ^ {2}} + \ln \left|  rac {1 + t}{1 - t} ight| + C \ & = -  rac {\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}}{x} + \ln \left|  rac {\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}}{\sqrt {1 + x} - \sqrt {1 - x}} ight| + C. \end{array}
$$
【注】此题也可利用倒代换. 令 $x =  rac{1}{t}$ , 则 $\mathrm{d} x = - rac{1}{t^2} \mathrm{d} t$ , 故
$$
\int  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} \sqrt { rac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \mathrm{d} x = - \int \sqrt { rac {t - 1}{t + 1}} \mathrm{d} t.
$$
再令 $\sqrt{ rac{t - 1}{t + 1}} = u$ ，去根号继续求解即可.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} 	ext {(VI)} & \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} (1 + 	an x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} (1 + 2 	an x + 	an^ {2} x) \mathrm{d} x = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \sec^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x \mathrm{d} x \ & = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \mathrm{d} (	an x) + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x \mathrm{d} x \ & = \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x - 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x \mathrm{d} x + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x \mathrm{d} x \ & = \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x + C. \end{array}
$$
【注】此题通过分部积分法消去 $2 \int \mathrm{e}^{2x} 	an x \, \mathrm{d}x$ ，这类问题一般也可凑微分.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \sec^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x \mathrm{d} x & = \int (\mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \sec^ {2} x + 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x) \mathrm{d} x \ & = \int \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x) = \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} 	an x + C. \end{array}

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.solution:
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {证(I)} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (x - b) f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (x - b) \mathrm{d} f ^ {\prime} (x) \\ & = (x - a) (x - b) f ^ {\prime} (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} (2 x - a - b) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {a} ^ {b} (a + b - 2 x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {a} ^ {b} (a + b - 2 x) \mathrm{d} f (x) \\ & = (a + b - 2 x) f (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} + 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = (a - b) [ f (a) + f (b) ] + 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}
$$
故
$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} (b - a) [ f (a) + f (b) ] + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (x - b) f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x.
$$
(Ⅱ) 方法一: 由(Ⅰ)有
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \left| \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} (b - a) [ f (a) + f (b) ] \right| & = \left| \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (x - b) f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| \\ & \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} | x - a | | x - b | | f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) | \mathrm{d} x \\ & \leqslant \frac {M}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (b - x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {M}{4} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (b - x) \mathrm{d} (x - a) ^ {2} \\ & = \frac {M}{4} \left[ (b - x) (x - a) ^ {2} \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} + \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & = \frac {M}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{3} (x - a) ^ {3} \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} = \frac {M}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{3} (b - a) ^ {3} = \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{1 2} M. \end{array}
$$
方法二: 应用泰勒公式证明.
将 $f(u)$ 在 $x \in (a, b)$ 处展开，再代入端点 $u = a$ 和 $u = b$ ，有
$$
f (a) = f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (a - x) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1})}{2 !} (a - x) ^ {2}, \xi_ {1} \in (a, x);\tag{①}
$$
$$
f (b) = f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (b - x) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2})}{2 !} (b - x) ^ {2}, \xi_ {2} \in (x, b).\tag{②}
$$
由 ① + ②, 得
$$
f (a) + f (b) = 2 f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (a + b - 2 x) + \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) (a - x) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) (b - x) ^ {2}.
$$
上式两边从 a 到 b 积分, 得
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {a} ^ {b} [ f (a) + f (b) ] \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {a} ^ {b} (a + b - 2 x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \\ & \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} [ f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) (a - x) ^ {2} + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) (b - x) ^ {2} ] \mathrm{d} x \end{array}\tag{③}
$$
而
$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} [ f (a) + f (b) ] \mathrm{d} x = (b - a) [ f (a) + f (b) ],
$$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (a + b - 2 x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {a} ^ {b} (a + b - 2 x) \mathrm{d} f (x) \\ & = (a + b - 2 x) f (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} + 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \end{array}
$$
$$
= (a - b) [ f (a) + f (b) ] + 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x,
$$
将其代入 ③ 式, 整理可得
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \left| \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} (b - a) [ f (a) + f (b) ] \right| & = \frac {1}{8} \left| \int_ {a} ^ {b} [ f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) (a - x) ^ {2} + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) (b - x) ^ {2} ] \mathrm{d} x \right| \\ & \leqslant \frac {1}{8} \left[ \int_ {a} ^ {b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) | (a - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {a} ^ {b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) | (b - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & \leqslant \frac {M}{8} \left[ \int_ {a} ^ {b} (a - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {a} ^ {b} (b - x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & = \frac {M}{8} \cdot \frac {2}{3} (b - a) ^ {3} = \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{1 2} M. \end{array}
$$
【注】若 $f(x)\geqslant 0$ ，则
$$
\left| \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} (b - a) [ f (a) + f (b) ] \right| \leqslant \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{1 2} M,
$$
可看作用梯形的面积 $\frac{1}{2} (b - a)[f(a) + f(b)]$ 作为 $\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x$ 的近似值，其绝对误差不超过 $\frac{(b - a)^3}{12} M.$

questions.text: 计算 $I = \int \frac{\mathrm{e}^{-\sin x} \cdot \sin 2x}{\sin^4 \left( \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{x}{2} \right)} \, \mathrm{d}x.$
questions.solution: 解 $I=\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-\sin x}\cdot2\sin x\cos x}{\left[\sin^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{x}{2}\right)\right]^{2}}\mathrm{d}x=\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-\sin x}\cdot2\sin x\cos x}{\left[\frac{1-\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)}{2}\right]^{2}}\mathrm{d}x=8\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-\sin x}(-\sin x)\mathrm{d}(-\sin x)}{(1-\sin x)^{2}}\xlongequal{-\sin x=u}8\int\mathrm{e}^{u}\cdot\frac{u}{(1+u)^{2}}\mathrm{d}u=8\int\mathrm{e}^{u}\left[\frac{1}{1+u}-\frac{1}{(1+u)^{2}}\right]\mathrm{d}u=8\left[\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{1+u}\mathrm{d}u-\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{(1+u)^{2}}\mathrm{d}u\right]=8\left(\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{1+u}\mathrm{d}u+\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{1+u}-\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{1+u}\mathrm{d}u\right)+C=\frac{8\mathrm{e}^{u}}{1+u}+C=\frac{8\mathrm{e}^{-\sin x}}{1-\sin x}+C$.

questions.text:
求下列积分:
(I) $\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(x^{2}\ln\frac{1+x}{1-x}-\cos x\right)\mathrm{d}x;$
$$
(I I) \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (2 + \sin x) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} d x;
$$
$$
(I I I) \int_ {- 2} ^ {2} (x + | x |) e ^ {- | x |} d x;
$$
$$
(I V) \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {2 x ^ {2} + x \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}\right)}{1 + \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x.
$$
questions.solution:
(5) 解（Ⅰ）在对称区间上积分,考查被积函数的奇偶性.
$\ln rac{1+x}{1-x}=\ln(1+x)-\ln(1-x)$ 是奇函数, $\cos x$ 是偶函数,故
$$
\int_ {-  rac {\pi}{4}} ^ { rac {\pi}{4}} \left(x ^ {2} \ln  rac {1 + x}{1 - x} - \cos xight) \mathrm{d} x = 0 - 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{4}} \cos x \mathrm{d} x = - \sqrt {2}.
$$
$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (2 + \sin x) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + 0 = 4 \cdot  rac {1}{4} \pi = \pi .
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 2} ^ {2} (x + | x |) \mathrm{e} ^ {- | x |} \mathrm{d} x & = 0 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} | x | \mathrm{e} ^ {- | x |} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} x \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \mathrm{d} x \ & = - 2 x \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {2} + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \mathrm{d} x = 2 - 6 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2}. \end{array}
$$
（Ⅳ）由题可知， $ rac{2x^{2}}{1+\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}$ 是偶函数， $ rac{x(\mathrm{e}^{x}+\mathrm{e}^{-x})}{1+\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}$ 是奇函数，故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1}  rac {2 x ^ {2} + x (\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x})}{1 + \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x & = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1}  rac {x ^ {2}}{1 + \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x + 0 \ & = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x - 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = 4 - \pi . \end{array}

questions.solution:
(5) 解 (I) 对 $\forall x \in [0,1], f(u)$ 在点 $x$ 处的泰勒展开式为
$f(u) = f(x) + f'(x)(u - x) + \frac{f''(\xi)}{2!} (u - x)^2,\xi$ 介于 $x$ 与 $u$ 之间.
代入端点 u = 1, u = 0, 有
$$
1 = f (1) = f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (1 - x) + \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) (1 - x) ^ {2}, \xi_ {1}
$$
$$
1 = f (0) = f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (0 - x) + \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) (0 - x) ^ {2},   \xi_ {2}   \text {介于}   0   \text {与}   x   \text {之间}.
$$
①—②，得
$$
f ^ {\prime} (x) = - \frac {1}{2} \Big [ f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) (1 - x) ^ {2} - f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) x ^ {2} \Big ].
$$
当 $x = 0$ 或 $x = 1$ 时，有
$$
\mid f ^ {\prime} (0) \mid = \frac {1}{2} \mid f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) \mid \leqslant \frac {1}{2} M,
$$
$$
\mid f ^ {\prime} (1) \mid = \frac {1}{2} \mid f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) \mid \leqslant \frac {1}{2} M.
$$
当 $x \in (0,1)$ 时，有
$$
\mid f ^ {\prime} (x) \mid \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \Big [ \mid f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) \mid (1 - x) ^ {2} + \mid f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) \mid x ^ {2} \Big ].
$$
令 $|f''(\xi)| = \max \left\{ |f''(\xi_1)|, |f''(\xi_2)| \right\}, \xi \in (0,1)$ ，则
$$
\mid f ^ {\prime} (x) \mid \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \mid f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) \mid \left[ (1 - x) ^ {2} + x ^ {2} \right] \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \mid f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) \mid \leqslant \frac {1}{2} M.
$$
综上所述，当 $x \in [0,1]$ 时，所证不等式成立.
(Ⅱ) $f(x)$ 在 $\left[0,\frac{1}{2}\right]$ 与 $\left[\frac{1}{2},1\right]$ 上分别应用拉格朗日中值定理，有
$$
f (x) = f (0) + f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {1}) x = 1 + x f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {1}), 0 <   \xi_ {1} <   x \leqslant \frac {1}{2};
$$
$$
f (x) = f (1) + (x - 1) f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {2}) = 1 + (x - 1) f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {2}), \frac {1}{2} \leqslant x <   \xi_ {2} <   1.
$$
由（I）知， $|f'(x)| \leqslant \frac{1}{2} M$ ，故
$$
\mid f (x) \mid = \mid 1 + x f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {1}) \mid \leqslant 1 + \frac {1}{2} M x, x \in \left[ 0, \frac {1}{2} \right];
$$
$$
\mid f (x) \mid = \mid 1 + (x - 1) f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {2}) \mid \leqslant 1 + \frac {1}{2} M (1 - x), x \in \left[ \frac {1}{2}, 1 \right].
$$
则
$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} | f (x) | \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} | f (x) | \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\quad \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \left(1 + \frac {1}{2} M x\right) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} \left[ 1 + \frac {1}{2} M (1 - x) \right] \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\quad = \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} M \cdot \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} \bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} + \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} M \cdot \frac {1}{2} (x - 1) ^ {2} \bigg | _ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1}} \\ & {\quad = 1 + \frac {1}{8} M.} \end{array}
$$

questions.text: 设 $f(\ln x) = \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}$ ，求 $I = \int f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
questions.solution: 解 令 $\ln x=t$，则 $x=\mathrm{e}^t$. 故 $f(t)=f(\ln x)=\frac{\ln(1+\mathrm{e}^t)}{\mathrm{e}^t}$，于是 $I=\int f(x)\mathrm{d}x=\int\frac{\ln(1+\mathrm{e}^{x})}{\mathrm{e}^{x}}\mathrm{d}x=-\int\ln(1+\mathrm{e}^{x})\mathrm{d}(\mathrm{e}^{-x})=-\mathrm{e}^{-x}\ln(1+\mathrm{e}^{x})+\int\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{x}}\right)\mathrm{d}x=x-(1+\mathrm{e}^{-x})\ln(1+\mathrm{e}^{x})+C$.

$$

questions.text:
设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, +\infty)$ 上有连续的二阶导数, 且 $|f''(x)| \leqslant 1$ .
(I) 证明: $\left|\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\mathrm{d}x-f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\right| \leqslant \frac{1}{24};$
(II) 若对任意的 $x \in [0, +\infty)$ , 有 $f(x) = f(x + 1), n$ 为正整数. 证明: $\left|\int_{0}^{n} f(x) \mathrm{d}x\right| \leqslant n\left[\frac{1}{6} + |f(0)|\right]$ .
questions.solution:
(6) 解 (I) $f(x)$ 在 $x = \frac{1}{2}$ 处的泰勒展开式为
$f(x)=f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)+f'\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\left(x-\frac{1}{2}\right)+\frac{f''(\xi)}{2!}\left(x-\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2},\xi$ 介于 $\frac{1}{2}$ 与 x 之间.
①
①式两边积分,有
$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) + 0 + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}
$$
其中
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = 0.
$$
故
$$
\left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x - f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) \right| = \left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right| \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2 4}.
$$
(Ⅱ) 由 $f(x)=f(x+1)$ ，知 $f'(x)=f'(x+1)$ .
当 $x = 0$ 时，有 $f(0) = f(1), f'(0) = f'(1)$ ，且 $\int_0^n f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x = n\int_0^1 f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
利用泰勒公式, 将 $f(x)$ 在 x = 0 与 x = 1 处分别展开, 得
$$
f (x) = f (0) + f ^ {\prime} (0) x + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1})}{2 !} x ^ {2},   \xi_ {1}   \text {介于}   0   \text {与}   x   \text {之间};
$$
$$
f (x) = f (1) + f ^ {\prime} (1) (x - 1) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2})}{2 !} (x - 1) ^ {2},   \xi_ {2}   \text {介于}   1   \text {与}   x   \text {之间}.
$$
上边两式积分,得
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f (0) + \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} (0) + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x,\tag{①}
$$
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f (1) - \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} (1) + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) (x - 1) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x.\tag{②}
$$
①+②,得
$$
\begin{array}{r l} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x & = f (0) + f (1) + \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) (x - 1) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right], \\ \left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| & \leqslant \frac {1}{2} (| f (0) | + | f (1) |) + \frac {1}{4} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {1} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) | x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) | (x - 1) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & \leqslant | f (0) | + \frac {1}{4} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} (x - 1) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ & = | f (0) | + \frac {1}{4} \left[ \frac {1}{3} x ^ {3} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} + \frac {1}{3} (x - 1) ^ {3} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} \right] \\ & = | f (0) | + \frac {1}{4} \left(\frac {1}{3} + \frac {1}{3}\right) = | f (0) | + \frac {1}{6}. \\ & \left| \int_ {0} ^ {n} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| = n \left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| \leqslant n \left[ \frac {1}{6} + | f (0) | \right]. \end{array}
$$
所以

questions.text:
求下列积分:
$$
(I) \int_ {- 3} ^ {2} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} d x;
$$
$$
(I I) \int_ {- 1} ^ {x} (1 - | t |) d t (x \geqslant - 1);
$$
$$
(I I I) \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} | x - y | \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x (| y | \leqslant 1);
$$
$$
(I V) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} d x.
$$
questions.solution:
(7) 解（I）由于 $\min\{2,x^{2}\}= egin{cases}2,&-3\leqslant x\leqslant-\sqrt{2},\x^{2},&-\sqrt{2}<x<\sqrt{2},\end{cases}$ 故
2, $\sqrt{2} \leqslant x \leqslant 2,$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 3} ^ {2} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {- 3} ^ {- \sqrt {2}} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \sqrt {2}} ^ {\sqrt {2}} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x \ & = \int_ {- 3} ^ {- \sqrt {2}} 2 \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \sqrt {2}} ^ {\sqrt {2}} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} 2 \mathrm{d} x = 1 0 -  rac {8}{3} \sqrt {2}. \end{array}
$$
(Ⅱ) 当 $-1 \leqslant x < 0$ 时，
$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {x} (1 - | t |) \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {- 1} ^ {x} (1 + t) \mathrm{d} t =  rac {(1 + t) ^ {2}}{2} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {x} =  rac {(1 + x) ^ {2}}{2};
$$
当 $x \geqslant 0$ 时，
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 1} ^ {x} (1 - | t |) \mathrm{d} t & = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (1 + t) \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {0} ^ {x} (1 - t) \mathrm{d} t \ & = 1 -  rac {1}{2} (1 - x) ^ {2}. \end{array}
$$
【注】 注意当 $x \geqslant 0$ 时，
$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {x} (1 - | t |) \mathrm{d} t 
eq \int_ {- 1} ^ {x} (1 - t) \mathrm{d} t.
$$
（Ⅲ）分段积分，去绝对值符号.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} | x - y | \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {- 1} ^ {y} (y - x) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {y} ^ {1} (x - y) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x \ & = (y - x) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {y} + \int_ {- 1} ^ {y} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x + (x - y) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \Big | _ {y} ^ {1} - \int_ {y} ^ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x \ & = 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {y} - (y + 2) \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} - y \mathrm{e}. \end{array}
$$
$$
 egin{array}{r l} (\mathrm{IV}) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \left| \sin  rac {x}{2} - \cos  rac {x}{2} ight| \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \left(\cos  rac {x}{2} - \sin  rac {x}{2}ight) \mathrm{d} x + \ & \quad \int_ { rac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \left(\sin  rac {x}{2} - \cos  rac {x}{2}ight) \mathrm{d} x = 4 (\sqrt {2} - 1). \end{array}
$$
【注】因为 $\sqrt{1-\sin x}$ 在 $[0,\pi]$ 上关于直线 $x= rac{\pi}{2}$ 对称，所以
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \left(\cos  rac {x}{2} - \sin  rac {x}{2}ight) \mathrm{d} x \ & = 2 \left(2 \sin  rac {x}{2} \Big | _ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} + 2 \cos  rac {x}{2} \Big | _ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}}ight) = 4 (\sqrt {2} - 1). \end{array}

questions.solution: 解 当 $x\to 0$ 时，$\sqrt{1+2x^3}-1\sim\frac{1}{2}\cdot2x^3=x^3$. 又 $\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}x\sqrt{4-x^{2}u^{2}}\mathrm{d}u\xlongequal{xu=t}\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2x}\sqrt{4-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t$，所以 $\text{原式}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2x}\sqrt{4-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t-2x}{x^{3}}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{4-4x^{2}}\cdot2-2}{3x^{2}}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{2(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}-1)}{3x^{2}}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{2\cdot\frac{1}{2}(-x^{2})}{3x^{2}}=-\frac{1}{3}$.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text:
求下列积分:
$$
(I) \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (x + \sin^ {2} x) \cos^ {2} x d x;
$$
$$
(I I) \int_ {0} ^ {1} x (1 - x ^ {4}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} d x;
$$
$$
(I I I) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \sin t d t;
$$
$$
(I V) \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}} + \sqrt {\left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {3}} \right] d x.
$$
questions.solution:
(8) 解（Ⅰ）由题可知， $x \cos^{2} x$ 是奇函数， $\sin^{2} x \cos^{2} x$ 为偶函数，故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {-  rac {\pi}{2}} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} (x + \sin^ {2} x) \cos^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x & = 0 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} x \cos^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} x (1 - \sin^ {2} x) \mathrm{d} x \ & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x - 2 \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {4} x \mathrm{d} x \ & = 2 	imes  rac {1}{2} 	imes  rac {\pi}{2} - 2 	imes  rac {3}{4} 	imes  rac {1}{2} 	imes  rac {\pi}{2} =  rac {\pi}{8}. \end{array}
$$
(Ⅱ) 令 $x^{2} = \sin t$ ，则 $2x\mathrm{d}x = \cos t\mathrm{d}t$ ，故
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} x \left(1 - x ^ {4}ight) ^ { rac {3}{2}} \mathrm{d} x =  rac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \cdot \cos^ {3} t \mathrm{d} t =  rac {1}{2} 	imes  rac {3}{4} 	imes  rac {1}{2} 	imes  rac {\pi}{2} =  rac {3 \pi}{3 2}.
$$
$$
(\mathrm{III}) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \sin t \mathrm{d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \mathrm{d} (\cos t) = (- t \cos t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos t \mathrm{d} t = \pi .
$$
【注】利用结论 $\int_{0}^{\pi}xf(\sin x)\mathrm{d}x= rac{\pi}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}f(\sin x)\mathrm{d}x$ ，有
$\int_{0}^{\pi} x \sin^{n} x \, \mathrm{d}x =  rac{\pi}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin^{n} x \, \mathrm{d}x = \pi \int_{0}^{ rac{\pi}{2}} \sin^{n} x \, \mathrm{d}x = \left\{  egin{array}{l}  rac{(n-1)!!}{n!!} \cdot  rac{\pi^{2}}{2}, \  rac{(n-1)!!}{n!!} \cdot \pi, \end{array} ight.$ 为正偶数， $n$ 为正奇数，
故(Ⅲ)可利用结论求解,即 $\int_{0}^{\pi}t\sin tdt= rac{\pi}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin tdt=\pi.$
(Ⅳ) 分别积分计算：
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}}   \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - (x - 1) ^ {2}}   \mathrm{d} x \stackrel {x - 1 = t} {=} \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}}   \mathrm{d} t =  rac {1}{4} \pi ,
$$
$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {(1 - x ^ {2}) ^ {3}}   \mathrm{d} x \xlongequal {x = \sin t} \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} t   \mathrm{d} t =  rac {3}{4} 	imes  rac {1}{2} 	imes  rac {\pi}{2} =  rac {3 \pi}{1 6},
$$
故
$$
	ext {   原积分   } =  rac {\pi}{4} +  rac {3 \pi}{1 6} =  rac {7 \pi}{1 6}.

questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x)$ 连续, $\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{x} = 2$ , 求 $\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_0^x f(x)f(x - t)dt}{\int_0^x tf(x - t)dt}$ .
questions.solution: 解 由于 $\int_{0}^{x}f(x-t)\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{x-t=u}\int_{x}^{0}f(u)(-\mathrm{d}u)=\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u$，$\int_{0}^{x}tf(x-t)\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{x-t=u}\int_{x}^{0}f(u)\cdot(x-u)(-\mathrm{d}u)=x\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u-\int_{0}^{x}uf(u)\mathrm{d}u$，故 $\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_{0}^{x}f(x)f(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}{\int_{0}^{x}tf(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)\int_{0}^{x}f(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}{\int_{0}^{x}tf(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{x}\cdot\frac{x\int_{0}^{x}f(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}{\int_{0}^{x}tf(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}=2\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x\int_{0}^{x}f(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}{\int_{0}^{x}tf(x-t)\mathrm{d}t}\xlongequal{x-t=u}2\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u}{x\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u-\int_{0}^{x}uf(u)\mathrm{d}u}=2\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u+xf(x)}{\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u}=2+2\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{f(x)}{x}}{\frac{\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u}{x^{2}}}$. 又 $\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u}{x^{2}}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{2x}=\frac{1}{2}\times2=1$，故 $\text{原式}=2+2\times\frac{2}{1}=6$.

questions.text:
计算下列积分:
$$
(I) \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x + 1} + \mathrm{e} ^ {3 - x}};
$$
$$
(I I) \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {| x - x ^ {2} |}}.
$$
questions.solution:
(9) 解 (Ⅰ) 令 x - 1 = t，则
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x + 1} + \mathrm{e} ^ {3 - x}} & = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2} (\mathrm{e} ^ {x - 1} + \mathrm{e} ^ {1 - x})} =  rac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty}  rac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{e} ^ {t} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- t}} \ & =  rac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty}  rac {\mathrm{e} ^ {t}}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {2 t}} \mathrm{d} t =  rac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \arctan \left. \mathrm{e} ^ {t} ight| _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} =  rac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \left( rac {\pi}{2} -  rac {\pi}{4}ight) =  rac {\pi}{4 \mathrm{e} ^ {2}}. \end{array}
$$
（Ⅱ）积分区间内 x = 1 是瑕点，在区间 $\left[ rac{1}{2}, 1ight)$ 和 $\left(1,  rac{3}{2}ight]$ 上分别计算积分.
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ { rac {1}{2}} ^ { rac {3}{2}}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {| x - x ^ {2} |}} & = \int_ { rac {1}{2}} ^ {1}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {x - x ^ {2}}} + \int_ {1} ^ { rac {3}{2}}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - x}} \ & = \int_ { rac {1}{2}} ^ {1}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt { rac {1}{4} - \left(x -  rac {1}{2}ight) ^ {2}}} + \int_ {1} ^ { rac {3}{2}}  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {\left(x -  rac {1}{2}ight) ^ {2} -  rac {1}{4}}} \ & = \arcsin (2 x - 1) \Big | _ { rac {1}{2}} ^ {1} + \ln \left[ \left(x -  rac {1}{2}ight) + \sqrt {\left(x -  rac {1}{2}ight) ^ {2} -  rac {1}{4}} ight] \Big | _ {1} ^ { rac {3}{2}} \ & =  rac {\pi}{2} + \ln (2 + \sqrt {3}). \end{array}
$$
【注】 积分公式：
$$
\int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}}} = \arcsin  rac {x}{a} + C, \int  rac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - a ^ {2}}} = \ln | x + \sqrt {x ^ {2} - a ^ {2}} | + C.

questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x) = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} |x - t| \sin t dt, x \in (-\infty, +\infty)$ , 求 $f(x)$ 的单调区间与极值.
questions.solution:
(10) 解 当 x < 0 时, 有
$$
 egin{array}{r l} f (x) & = \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} (t - x) \sin t \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} t \sin t \mathrm{d} t - x \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \sin t \mathrm{d} t \ & = - \left(t \cos t \Big | _ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} - \int_ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \mathrm{d} tight) - x (- \cos t) \Big | _ {0} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} = 1 - x. \end{array}
$$
同理，当 $x >  rac{\pi}{2}$ 时， $f(x) = x - 1$ 。当 $0 \leqslant x \leqslant  rac{\pi}{2}$ 时，
$$
f (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} (x - t) \sin t \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {x} ^ { rac {\pi}{2}} (t - x) \sin t \mathrm{d} t = x - 2 \sin x + 1.
$$
故
$$
f (x) = \left\{  egin{array}{l l} 1 - x, & x <   0, \ x - 2 \sin x + 1, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant  rac {\pi}{2}, \ x - 1, & x >  rac {\pi}{2}. \end{array} ight.
$$
计算可知：
$$
f _ {-} ^ {\prime} (0) = f _ {+} ^ {\prime} (0) = - 1, f _ {-} ^ {\prime} \left( rac {\pi}{2}ight) = f _ {+} ^ {\prime} \left( rac {\pi}{2}ight) = 1.
$$
当 $x < 0$ 时， $f'(x) = -1$ ；当 $x >  rac{\pi}{2}$ 时， $f'(x) = 1$ ；当 $0 \leqslant x \leqslant  rac{\pi}{2}$ 时，由 $f'(x) = 1 - 2\cos x = 0$ 得 $x =  rac{\pi}{3}$ .
由 $f''\left( rac{\pi}{3}ight) = \sqrt{3} > 0$ ，知 $f\left( rac{\pi}{3}ight) =  rac{\pi}{3} + 1 - \sqrt{3}$ 为极小值，无极大值.
单调递减区间为 $\left(-\infty, rac{\pi}{3}ight)$ ，单调递增区间为 $\left( rac{\pi}{3},+\inftyight)$ .

questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, \pi]$ 上有二阶连续导数， $f(0) = 2, f(\pi) = 1$ ，计算 $I = \int_{0}^{\pi} [f(x) + f''(x)] \sin x \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
questions.solution:
(11) 解 $I=\int_{0}^{\pi}[f(x)+f''(x)]\sin x\,dx=\int_{0}^{\pi}f(x)\sin x\,dx+\int_{0}^{\pi}f''(x)\sin x\,dx.$
①
又
$$
 egin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin x \mathrm{d} [ f ^ {\prime} (x) ] = f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \cos x \mathrm{d} x \ & = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \cos x \mathrm{d} x \ & = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos x \mathrm{d} [ f (x) ] \ & = - f (x) \cos x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) (- \sin x) \mathrm{d} x \ & = f (\pi) + f (0) - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x \ & = 3 - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}
$$
将结果代入 ① 式, 得 I = 3.

questions.text: 计算 $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\int_{0}^{2x}\left|1-\frac{t}{x}\right|\sin tdt}{x^{2}}$ .
questions.solution: 解 $\int_{0}^{2x}\Bigg|1-\frac{t}{x}\Bigg|\sin t\ \mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{\frac{t}{x}=u}x\int_{0}^{2}|1-u|\sin(xu)\mathrm{d}u$. 原式 $=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x\int_{0}^{2}|1-u|\sin(xu)\mathrm{d}u}{x^{2}}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1}{x}\left[\int_{0}^{1}(1-u)\sin(xu)\mathrm{d}u+\int_{1}^{2}(u-1)\sin(xu)\mathrm{d}u\right]$. 再利用分部积分法，可得原式 $=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1}{x}\left(\frac{1-\cos2x}{x}+\frac{\sin2x-2\sin x}{x^{2}}\right)=\lim_{x\to 0}\left(\frac{1-\cos2x}{x^{2}}+\frac{\sin2x-2\sin x}{x^{3}}\right)=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{2}\cdot(2x)^{2}}{x^{2}}+\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{2(\cos x-1)\sin x}{x^{3}}=2-1=1$.

questions.subject: 高数
questions.chapter_title: 第三章 一元函数积分学及其应用
questions.text: 设 $F(x) = \int_{0}^{\sin x} f(tx^2) dt$ ，其中 $f(x)$ 为连续函数，求 $F'(x)$ ，并讨论 $F'(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处的连续性.
questions.solution:
(12) 解 当 $x 
eq 0$ 时，
$$
F (x) =  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} f (t x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} (t x ^ {2}) \stackrel {t x ^ {2} = s} {=}  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s,
$$
$$
F ^ {\prime} (x) = -  rac {2}{x ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s +  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x),
$$
$$
F ^ {\prime} (0) = \lim _ {x 	o 0}  rac {F (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x 	o 0}  rac {\int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s}{x ^ {3}}  rac {	ext {洛必达}}{	ext {法则}} \lim _ {x 	o 0}  rac {f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x)}{3 x ^ {2}} = f (0),
$$
即 $F(x)$ 在 x = 0 处可导. 故
$$
 egin{array}{r l} F ^ {\prime} (x) & = \left\{  egin{array}{l l} -  rac {2}{x ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s +  rac {1}{x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x), & x 
eq 0, \ f (0), & x = 0. \end{array} ight. \ & \lim _ {x 	o 0} F ^ {\prime} (x) = \lim _ {x 	o 0}  rac {- 2}{x ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s + 3 f (0) \ & = \lim _ {x 	o 0}  rac {- 2}{3 x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x) + 3 f (0) \ & = - 2 \lim _ {x 	o 0} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) \cdot \lim _ {x 	o 0}  rac {2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x}{3 x ^ {2}} + 3 f (0) \ & = f (0). \end{array}
$$
由 $\lim_{x	o0}F'(x)=f(0)=F'(0)$ ，知 $F'(x)$ 在x=0处连续.
